brief.text: Refine NOCTILUS: make sail about 40% taller, add polished brass collars around the bases of all three sensor masts, preserve hull and removable cradle.

revisions.title: Saved revision 1
revisions.description: A striking stylized nuclear submarine with a long midnight-blue teardrop hull, tall streamlined sail, raised periscopes and sensor masts, clean diving planes, sculpted stern with brass propeller, subtle panel seams, and a simple removable display cradle.
